propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the specification and acceptance criteria for message-status webhooks with the API engineering squad.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the specification work, the work sample is the specification and the product director confirmed it.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was an associate product manager on the messaging API from March 2024 to August 2026, as confirmed by the employer's people team.
propositions.rationale: The HR verification note records the employer's written role history, which gives two years and six months of product management on an API product.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has eight years of product management experience on software products.
propositions.rationale: The eight years in the resume entry are the candidate's whole time at the company, and the same entry shows support and QA roles until March 2024; product management runs from March 2024 to August 2026, and the qualification rule forbids inferring experience from duration alone.

expectedGap: Documented product management experience runs from March 2024 to August 2026, two years and six months, short of the five-year requirement; the eight years count support and QA roles as well.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the employer-confirmed role history and the documented specification, discovery and adoption work; do not state eight years of product management or count support and QA time as product management.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask the candidate to separate the time spent in support, QA and product management, and whether any product responsibilities before March 2024 carried a product title.

signatures: eight years in the product organisation
